task: Review the supplied Beat My Track threat assessment and check game/backend controls, IAM, public APIs, cloud exposure, cost attacks, secrets/deployment and monitoring.
verdict: Partly covered. Good account, data-validation and storage foundations; significant competitive-integrity and production-operational gaps remain. This is a scoped assessment, not a security certification.

scope.local: Current combined workspace source, existing attack/control suites and three current disposable probes.
scope.live: Read-only configuration inventory of project beat-my-track: project IAM, service accounts/keys, Cloud SQL, storage, secrets metadata/IAM, billing budget, logging and Monitoring; owned Cloud Run resources and repository in europe-west1.
scope.environment: The only API service observed in europe-west1 is explicitly retained development/staging, not an asserted production deployment.
scope.mutations: No game/backend source, live infrastructure, IAM, accounts, queues, billing settings, secret payloads or provider entitlements changed. No live attack, purchase or race submission.
scope.artifacts: Raw cloud descriptions remain in ignored build/security-coverage-2026-10-21/private-cloud. They may contain configuration; do not publish that directory.

game_coverage.area: Race times, modified physics, competitive results
game_coverage.covered: Pinned track/car/build tickets; authenticated uploads; monotonic bounded trajectory; broad car speed/continuity; ordered gates and five laps; idempotent best-only scoring.
game_coverage.gap: Client-supplied positions do not prove the car followed canonical physics. A manufactured plausible trajectory passed the actual checker in a fresh synthetic-geometry probe. No automatic exceptional-record quarantine/independent physics verification was found. Incident-free bonuses also rely on submitted incident fields.

game_coverage.covered: One best per player/contract; unique verified finishers; one replaceable rating per player; completion required; creators and artificial drivers cannot rate; artificial/public populations separated.
game_coverage.gap: These controls do not identify one person using many real Google accounts, collusion or intentional low-skill placement. No account-cluster/opponent-diversity/sandbagging detector was found in reviewed code.

game_coverage.covered: Server-owned prices/wallets; atomic/idempotent cosmetic unlocks; account/product/state-bound Play verification endpoint and token deduplication; signed AdMob proof helper; idempotent resume receipts.
game_coverage.gap: Store remains unavailable; live Play SDK/provider setup, refunds/voided-purchase reconciliation and production rewarded-ad SSV fulfillment are incomplete. AdMob signature helper is not wired into a production reward callback route. Clean-race reporting inherits trajectory trust.

game_coverage.status: SUBSTANTIAL implemented coverage; capacity acceptance remains
game_coverage.covered: Data-only JSON; no arbitrary scene/script loading; 512KiB track limit; 96 points/pieces/objects with coordinate/paint/object allowlists and bounds; finite/depth/node validation; request/decompression/parser/queue/evidence budgets and worker timeout.
game_coverage.gap: This does not prove all worst-case legal geometry is fast on every device or that every engine/native dependency is vulnerability-free.

game_coverage.status: SUBSTANTIAL technical controls; human operations remain
game_coverage.covered: Versioned sharing consent, private reports/appeals, blocking and challenge interaction fences; owner-only moderation and revocation. Fresh probes deny another account's private run/publication/draft and all 47 current admin GET routes.
game_coverage.gap: Report review staffing, response times and evasion/account-cluster detection are operational tasks. This was not an exhaustive authorization proof for every method/endpoint.

confirmed: Dedicated runtime, migrator and operator accounts use scoped roles instead of project Owner/Editor.
No USER_MANAGED keys on any of the four enumerated service accounts.
Migration/admin DB secret and application DB secret have separate resource bindings.
gaps: Default Compute service account still has project-wide roles/editor.
Runtime identity is shared by API/worker and can access the administrator bearer-key secret.
No successful verification of an enforced key-creation policy or developer-account MFA.

confirmed: Google token signatures/audience/nonce checks, refresh reuse revocation, account fences and current ownership/admin-denial tests pass.
Bounded JSON/gzip/body parsing, authenticated upload admission, per-player/shared budgets and evidence retention exist.
gaps: Public Cloud Run API has ingress all and allUsers run.invoker; it intentionally runs BMT_ENVIRONMENT=development with development login, artificial drivers and purchase simulation enabled.
Admin endpoints share that public service; configured access is the legacy bearer-key path, with no named-staff/MFA configuration observed.
No separate load-balancer/Cloud Armor front door was evidenced; application rate limits are not a complete distributed-DDoS/cost shield.

cloud_coverage.status: MOSTLY COVERED for inspected data exposure; recovery hardening incomplete
confirmed: Object bucket enforces Public Access Prevention and uniform bucket-level access; no public IAM binding.
Cloud SQL has public IPv4 but no authorized-network CIDRs; Cloud Run uses its Cloud SQL connection/connector. A public IP alone is not proof of direct anonymous DB access.
All five observed jobs have no public invoker binding.
SQL deletion protection and daily backups are enabled; latest three automated backups succeeded.
gaps: SQL sslMode permits unencrypted and encrypted direct connections; requireSsl=false. This does not mean the Cloud SQL connector traffic is unencrypted.
Point-in-time recovery is disabled; seven backups retained.
No restore exercise or NAS/router/DSM exposure inspection was performed.

confirmed: API service-level min/max are 1/2, overriding the looser revision maximum20 for normal service scaling; concurrency16, timeout60s, CPU1 and memory1024Mi.
One manually scaled worker, bounded jobs, application body/queue/upload/evidence quotas.
One EUR10/month project budget with 50/80/100 percent CURRENT_SPEND thresholds; credits excluded.
gaps: Observed budget has alert thresholds, no service filter/spend-cap enforcement and no Pub/Sub automation.
No tested emergency cost-response procedure or external abuse shield.
Two service instances do not bound storage, egress, logs, SQL or other project services; low traffic can still cause service denial or costs.
Cloud SQL disk is fixed10GB with auto-resize off: that bounds disk growth but needs capacity alerts to avoid exhaustion.

confirmed: Four secrets are held in Secret Manager with per-secret access bindings; live containers use secret references.
Runtime images pinned by digest, Python/wheels hash-pinned, Godot version/hash checked, nonroot container and local deployment ownership/backup guards.
Limited current-tree key/token-pattern scan: 9627 nonignored text files checked, zero matches; pip check passed.
gaps: Artifact Registry explicitly reports SCANNING_DISABLED because Container Scanning API is not enabled.
No secret rotation schedule observed in metadata; rotation history/payload contents were not read.
GitHub branch protection, remote CI permissions, developer MFA and compromise recovery are not verified; no Git-history secret scan or fresh dependency CVE scan performed.

confirmed: Cloud Logging and Monitoring APIs enabled; required Admin Activity/System Event sink and default sink present.
Application structured request correlation and administrator-command audit records exist.
Default log-bucket retention30days; daily backups succeed.
gaps: Zero Cloud Monitoring alert policies, zero uptime-check configurations and zero log-based metrics in project.
Project IAM auditConfigs is empty, with no project parent returned; Data Access audit logging is not explicitly configured here.
Independent Studio watchdog/log collector/external notifications remain unconfigured in inspected runtime.
Notification-channel enumeration was not completed because the CLI beta component was unavailable; channel absence is not claimed.

findings.title: Default Compute account has project Editor
findings.action: Check all uses/impersonation paths, then remove or replace roles/editor with only required roles; keep dedicated workload accounts.

findings.type: intentional staging configuration and admin hardening
findings.title: Public development backend and legacy administrator bearer access
findings.action: Prepare a separate production configuration with developer/test/simulation features off, named administrator access with verified MFA or an identity-aware gateway, then disable legacy keys after replacement access is tested. Preserve owner-authorized staging behavior until an explicit change is requested.

findings.title: No active operational/security alert policies or uptime checks
findings.action: Configure and test independent outage, worker/queue lag, DB/storage capacity, 401/403/429/5xx spikes, IAM/secret changes and budget alerts; enable selected Data Access audit logs with a cost/retention plan.

findings.priority: HIGH for competitive integrity; explicit accepted tradeoff
findings.type: reproduced offline on synthetic trusted geometry
findings.title: Plausible fabricated trajectories can qualify
findings.action: Decide the tolerated cheat level. Compatible next measures are suspicious-record hold/review, anomaly rules and optional request-bound Play Integrity signals. Strong physics provenance would require revisiting the explicitly approved trajectory-only policy; do not silently restore full replay.

findings.title: Production purchase/refund/rewarded-ad lifecycle incomplete
findings.action: Finish real provider/client setup, durable completion/reconciliation, voided-purchase/refund policy and signed idempotent SSV reward delivery; perform sandbox-provider lifecycle acceptance before real money.

findings.title: EUR10 budget is an observed alert budget, not an enforced spend ceiling
findings.action: Keep the service maximum; assess a Cloud Run-specific spend-cap budget where supported, remembering it pauses service and does not cover SQL/storage/all project costs. Add egress/storage/log limits and a tested operator response. Do not automatically disable billing without an availability decision.

findings.title: No dedicated multi-account or coordinated-ranking abuse detection found
findings.action: Add measured account/finish/rating/placement anomaly review while retaining unlimited legitimate racing and avoiding blanket shared-IP bans.

findings.title: Container vulnerability scanning disabled
findings.action: Choose and enable a reviewed scanning/advisory workflow with patch response and deployment acceptance. Existing hashes protect artifact identity, not absence of vulnerabilities.

findings.title: SQL point-in-time recovery off and permissive direct TLS mode
findings.action: Review encrypted-only direct connection policy without breaking connector use; choose PITR/retention against cost and recovery objectives and conduct an isolated restore with erasure-journal reapplication.

corrections_to_supplied_assessment: There is one initial free publishing slot per account, not a monthly free slot. Monthly replenishment is explicitly unapproved.
Current race acceptance intentionally uses trajectories; deterministic full replay is an offline diagnostic, not an active competitive anti-cheat boundary.
Existing report/block/appeal/moderation tools, server-owned Coins and anti-resource-abuse tests already exist; they should not be presented as wholly missing.

Earlier BA01-BA04 findings from October14 are addressed in current code: authenticate before large upload admission, reject unsupported-method bodies, cap/retire publication evidence and coalesce/budget discovery snapshots. Their current regression tests passed; the old report is not current open-finding status.

native_recheck.explanation: Sandboxed Godot logged 'Failed to read the root certificate store'. A writable private APPDATA alone did not fix it. Identical three native tests passed with reviewed Windows-certificate-store access and task-local APPDATA; no assertions or runtime code changed.

unique_focused_tests.limit: Focused tests only, not a fresh complete backend suite. The accepted fabricated-trajectory probe passes by documenting exposure.

validation.skipped: Five SQLite row-concurrency cases require disposable PostgreSQL. 141 initial selections were excluded by 'not postgres and not canonical_three_rewinds_keep_original_verified_time'; PostgreSQL concurrency and that historical full-replay fixture are not claimed tested.
other: pip check: No broken requirements found.
Limited high-confidence current-tree secret-pattern scan: 9627 text files, zero matches; no history scan.

Read-only live inventory: project roles, four account/key inventories, four per-secret policies, one bucket, one SQL instance, one observed regional API, one worker, five jobs, one registry, project budget, sinks, alerts and uptime configurations.

references.topic: Public Cloud SQL IP and authorized networks
Integrity is an additional anti-abuse signal

limitations: No confirmed account takeover, live authorization exploit or server compromise was demonstrated.
No deployment, live mutation, secret payload read, actual purchase, live cheat, saturation, restore, NAS inspection, phone attachment check, device test or APK action.
Cloud Run/job/repository inventory is scoped to the known europe-west1 backend, not an exhaustive all-region/all-project assessment.
Compute firewall, Cloud Build trigger and effective key-creation-policy queries could not complete because the corresponding APIs were disabled; none were enabled.
First cloud attempt failed local TLS trust; retry used the project's existing Windows-trust CA bundle, with certificate verification left enabled.
Developer account MFA, remote source-control/CI settings, historic credential leaks, provider console configuration and real incident-notification delivery need separate evidence.
Current working tree contains substantial pre-existing work. Runtime source was not edited and no mixed-workspace commit was made.
